purpose: Collect native console output and OpGuard observations from the same instrumented launches.
interventions: No weighted gradient, artificial delay, optimizer patch, or CUDA Stream Sanitizer.
discovery_runs: Additional discovery runs are retained separately from the trace runs.
observation_scope: Python callsites within copied application and dependency sources; no claim of whole-graph or kernel coverage.
console_capture: Separate direct stdout/stderr redirection in a blocking launcher, bound to the backend capture_id.
reproduction_check: Compare all 20 native metric rows and report whether the original symptom survives instrumentation.
